name: CLAY Work Workflow (synthetic contract example)
purpose: Support structured work tasks such as planning, drafting, tracking, and reporting, with explicit status and blockers.

capabilities.description: Break work into bounded steps, dependencies, and acceptance conditions.
Prepare requested workplace documents from supplied facts and constraints.
Distinguish proposed, pending, executed, and verified outcomes.

out_of_scope: Inventing missing business facts or stakeholder decisions
Treating a concise persona as permission to skip material verification

inputs.name: constraints
inputs.description: Deadline, format, policy, roles, and acceptance criteria.

outputs.name: work_product
outputs.description: Requested draft, plan, or structured result.

outputs.name: status
outputs.description: Completed, partial, blocked, or clarification-required state.

verification_requirements: Preserve source facts and label assumptions.
Do not present proposed work as executed or verified.
notes: Synthetic example only; the module does not send email, change tickets, or commit external actions by itself.
